<result>I found both mechanisms. Here are my findings.

## 1. Delivery function (executes the outbound HTTP request)

**Function:** `Post`
**File:** `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go` (lines 119–180)

This is where the HTTP POST to the external URL actually executes. It marshals the payload, builds the request, optionally attaches an HMAC-SHA256 signature, and fires it via the shared SSRF-hardened client at line 152:

```go
// Post posts the message to webhook endpoint.
func Post(requestPayload *WebhookRequestPayload) error {
    ...
    req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", requestPayload.URL, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
    ...
    resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)   // line 152 — the actual outbound request
```

Supporting entry points in the same file:
- `PostAsync` (lines 184–196) enqueues a payload onto a bounded channel.
- An `init()` worker pool (lines 42–55) drains that queue and calls `Post` for each payload.

## 2. SSRF protection (blocks internal/private addresses)

There are two layers, both keyed off the same range check `isReservedIP`:

**Dial-time guard (defeats DNS rebinding):** `safeDialContext`
**File:** `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go` (lines 57–77)

Wired into `safeClient`'s transport (lines 32–37), it resolves the host at dial time and rejects any resolved IP in a reserved range:

```go
for _, ipStr := range ips {
    if ip := net.ParseIP(ipStr); ip != nil && isReservedIP(ip) {
        return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: connection to reserved/private IP address is not allowed")
    }
}
```

**URL validation (up-front, when a user saves a webhook):** `ValidateURL`
**File:** `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/validate.go` (lines 62–83)

Checks scheme is http/https, resolves the hostname, and rejects reserved IPs (lines 76–81).

**Core range check:** `isReservedIP`
**File:** `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/validate.go` (lines 44–54)

Tests an IP against `reservedNetworks`, the parsed form of `reservedCIDRs` (lines 14–23) which covers loopback (`127.0.0.0/8`, `::1/128`), RFC-1918 private ranges (`10/8`, `172.16/12`, `192.168/16`), link-local / cloud IMDS (`169.254.0.0/16`), and IPv6 ULA/link-local (`fc00::/7`, `fe80::/10`).

Note: there is an opt-out flag `AllowPrivateIPs` (validate.go lines 38–41). When set to `true`, `isReservedIP` short-circuits to `false`, disabling SSRF protection entirely for both layers — intended for self-hosted deployments targeting local-network services.

Related tests live in `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook_test.go`.</result>

content.text:
h02.

**Delivery function** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

The outbound HTTP request actually executes in `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), specifically at the `safeClient.Do(req)` call on line 152. Webhooks are usually fired via `PostAsync` (line 184), which enqueues the payload onto `asyncPostQueue`; background worker goroutines started in `init` (lines 42–55) drain that queue and call `Post`, which marshals the payload, sets HMAC signature headers, and sends the POST.

**Protection mechanism** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go` (dial-time) + `internal/webhook/validate.go`

The primary SSRF guard is `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`), wired into the shared `safeClient`'s `http.Transport.DialContext` (lines 32–37). At dial time it resolves the target hostname and rejects any address that falls in a reserved/private range via `isReservedIP` — resolving at connect time also defeats DNS-rebinding. `isReservedIP` and the blocklist of CIDRs (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local/cloud IMDS `169.254.169.254`, and IPv6 equivalents) live in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14` / `:44`. There is also an up-front `ValidateURL` check (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) enforcing http/https scheme and non-reserved resolution when a webhook is configured. Both paths can be disabled by the `AllowPrivateIPs` flag (`validate.go:41`) for self-hosted deployments.

So concisely:
- delivery function — `Post` (executes at `safeClient.Do`) — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (line 152)
- protection mechanism — `safeDialContext` / `isReservedIP` SSRF blocklist (plus `ValidateURL`) — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` and `internal/webhook/validate.go`
